checks.target: Front surface y <= -0.985; visually judge cheek fullness and short round muzzle against approved concept.
Rightward skin span <= 2.48 and middle-body vertical thickness >= 1.20; matched views must visibly show a plumper tighter S bend.
A third lower outward arm has real surface geometry; visually confirm three gentle branches and rounded tips.
Thickness/width <= 0.29; merged rendered mane must retain broad overlapping leaves rather than round bead lobes.
Real short rounded claw volume depth >= 0.080; visually verify all four fused plump paws and gentle claw tips.

limits: Geometric proxies accompany actual three-view appearance review; these values do not prove pixel-identical matching to a 2D concept.
Editable leaf geometry checks its construction shape; the merged runtime/rendered result is checked independently before acceptance.
